user.title: Sign in to CovaU
user.description: Enter your CovaU account number and password. For reauthentication, use the same account number.

account.title: Select an energy account
account.description: Choose the service to monitor. Add this integration again to monitor another service.

cost_setup.title: Optional cost estimates
cost_setup.description: Enable estimated billing-cycle costs and choose the monthly reset day. Short months reset on their last day.

cost_mapping.title: Map usage to a tariff
cost_mapping.description: Choose a tariff for {category}, or leave it unmapped. Feed-in rates are ex GST; free usage uses the available rate.

cost_supply.title: Select supply charges
cost_supply.description: Select daily supply charges to include. To change a previous mapping, restart configuration.

error.invalid_auth: CovaU rejected the account number or password.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect securely to CovaU. Check Internet access, including outbound TCP port 3011.
error.invalid_response: CovaU returned an unsupported response. The provider may have changed its API.
error.no_accounts: CovaU did not return any selectable services.
error.wrong_account: Reauthenticate using the same account number as this integration entry.
error.service_unavailable: The selected service is not available to this account.
error.invalid_billing_day: Choose a whole number between 1 and 31.
error.no_cost_mappings: Select at least one usage tariff or daily supply charge.

abort.already_configured: This account and service are already configured.
